<style data-tdb-initial-parallax-controls>
/* TDB initial parallax controls v1.1.0: Home and Location page head. */
html.tdb-slider-next .parallax-swiper_component > .swiper > .swiper_functions-btm.hide,
html.tdb-slider-desktop .parallax-swiper_component > .swiper_functions-btm.hide {

  position: absolute;
  z-index: 30;
  pointer-events: none;
}

html.tdb-slider-next .parallax-swiper_component > .swiper > .swiper_functions-btm.hide .swiper-pagination,
html.tdb-slider-desktop .parallax-swiper_component > .swiper_functions-btm.hide .swiper-pagination {
  display: none !important;
}

html.tdb-slider-next .parallax-swiper_component > .swiper > .swiper_functions-btm.hide :is(.swiper-btn-prev, .swiper-btn-next),
html.tdb-slider-desktop .parallax-swiper_component > .swiper_functions-btm.hide :is(.swiper-btn-prev, .swiper-btn-next) {
  display: flex !important;
  color: #fff;
  border-color: #fff;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  pointer-events: auto;
  transition: background-color 300ms ease, color 300ms ease, border-color 300ms ease;
}

html.tdb-slider-next .parallax-swiper_component > .swiper > .swiper_functions-btm.hide :is(.swiper-btn-prev, .swiper-btn-next).is-selected,
html.tdb-slider-desktop .parallax-swiper_component > .swiper_functions-btm.hide :is(.swiper-btn-prev, .swiper-btn-next).is-selected {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}

@media (max-width: 767px) and (orientation: portrait) {
  html.tdb-slider-next .parallax-swiper_component > .swiper {
    position: relative;
  }

  html.tdb-slider-next .parallax-swiper_component > .swiper > .swiper_functions-btm.hide {
    right: 2rem;
    bottom: 2.5rem;
    width: auto;
    padding-top: 0;
  }

  html.tdb-slider-next .parallax-swiper_component > .swiper > .swiper_functions-btm.hide .swiper-buttons-wrapper {
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  html.tdb-slider-desktop .parallax-swiper_component {
    position: relative;
  }

  html.tdb-slider-desktop .parallax-swiper_component > .swiper_functions-btm.hide {
    left: 50%;
    top: 50%;
    width: 100vw;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding: 0 3vw;
    align-items: center;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  }

  html.tdb-slider-desktop .parallax-swiper_component > .swiper_functions-btm.hide .swiper-buttons-wrapper {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0;
  }
}

/* Entry-page CTA: a single stationary layer, outside the moving slide track. */
.has-static-parallax-cta,
.has-static-parallax-cta > .swiper { position: relative; }
.has-static-parallax-cta .service-card-button-wrap { min-height: 2.75rem; }
.has-static-parallax-cta .tdb-parallax-cta-layer {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 20;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  padding: 2rem;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.has-static-parallax-cta .tdb-parallax-cta-layer.is-location { justify-content: flex-start; }
.has-static-parallax-cta .tdb-parallax-cta-layer [data-tdb-parallax-cta].button.is-secondary {
  pointer-events: auto;
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  /* The original .vip.animate class owned these glass colours. This
   * stationary button must override the generic opaque-white hover variant,
   * including the sticky :hover state left behind by touch browsers. */
  background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  color: #fff;
  border-color: #fff;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  transition: background-color 300ms ease, color 300ms ease, border-color 300ms ease;
}
.has-static-parallax-cta .tdb-parallax-cta-layer [data-tdb-parallax-cta].button.is-secondary.is-touch-held {
  background-color: #fff;
  color: #000;
  /* Store a settled white frame on navigation; only release uses the fade. */
  transition-duration: 0s;
}
.has-static-parallax-cta .tdb-parallax-cta-layer [data-tdb-parallax-cta].button.is-secondary:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid currentColor;
  outline-offset: 4px;
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .has-static-parallax-cta .tdb-parallax-cta-layer [data-tdb-parallax-cta].button.is-secondary:not(.is-touch-input):not([aria-disabled="true"]):hover {
    background-color: #fff;
    color: #000;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 767px) and (orientation: portrait) {
  .has-static-parallax-cta .tdb-parallax-cta-layer {
    justify-content: flex-start;
    padding-bottom: 2.5rem;
  }
}


/* Match the saved card before Swiper takes ownership on a rebuilt Back page. */
.has-static-parallax-cta > .swiper:not(.swiper-initialized) > .swiper-wrapper {
  transform: translate3d(calc(var(--tdb-parallax-initial-index, 0) * -100%), 0, 0);
}
</style>
